lead: Glass terrarium 100x45x45 cm with LAKOBEL glass on the back panel. Volume: 202.5 liters, horizontal format.

description.html: The back of this terrarium is made of Lacobel glass, that is, glass painted on the reverse side, instead of clear glass with film. A background like this is smooth, does not absorb moisture and wipes clean with a cloth. The dimensions are 100x45x45 cm, with a floor of 4500 cm² and a volume of about 202.5 liters.

The floor area exceeds the 100x40 cm minimum that an adult bearded dragon needs, and the extra 5 cm of width makes turning easier for it. A ball python and an adult corn snake have enough length for a warm hide at one end and a cool one at the other. The smooth back gives no grip for climbing, so add branches and rocks yourself.

We can fit a Lacobel background to other sizes as well, and this model also exists in a regular 100x45x45 version with film. The sides can still get a film of your choice. Let us know your dimensions and deadline, a build to order takes 7 to 14 days. We ship the finished terrarium with the Lacobel background by courier.
